transcript: Listening to 100 cast albums in 2026. Welcome to week five. In honour of Groundhog Day, of course we are listening to the original Broadway cast album of Groundhog Day. As extra credit, if you want to listen to another holiday related song, then definitely listen to Oliver Richman’s The Ballad of Phyllis and Phil. Tis the season, y'all, Tis the season. Now it is also Black History Month, so in honour of February, every week I'll be picking at least one show by a black composer. So this week our Beyond Broadway pick is the off Broadway cast album of Bella: An American Tall Tale by Kirsten Childs. One of my favourite underrated musical theatre composers. Definitely give this one a listen. I love this score so, so much. So those are our picks Groundhog Day and Bella: An American Tall Tale. And as a reminder, if you wanna discuss the cast albums with us, join our discord, it's a lot of fun over there. And if you're looking for all of the musical challenge selections, you can find playlists on all of the major streaming platforms, including Tidal, Spotify and Apple Music. Happy listening!
